verdict.rationale: Kong isn't a collections-based API client, but decK provides declarative import/export of Kong configuration in YAML/JSON (a portable format) [kong-docs-4][kong-docs-67], and Kong publishes/consumes OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specs via Dev Portal and its API directory [kong-docs-49][kong-docs-9], which supports moving API definitions between tools. This is not the Postman-style 'collection' import/export developers typically mean, and no evidence shows dedicated request-collection import/export across third-party clients. Missing for 10: explicit collection format support (e.g., Postman/Insomnia collection import/export), cross-tool interoperability testing, and independent confirmation of round-trip fidelity.
